packageRules.description: Dependabot owns GitHub Actions; see .github/dependabot.yml. Two bots on one ecosystem open a duplicate pull request for every bump.

The minor and patch tail as one pull request, merged once CI passes. Renovate merges it itself rather than through GitHub's auto-merge, which would not wait for CI because main has no required checks. Its merge is a push, so the deploy follows.
